svg.title: UML class diagram: CoordinateSystemUtilities
svg.desc: Static utility class with public Clamp, Normalize, Denormalize, and Distance methods and a private ValidateFiniteRange helper. Range mapping requires finite endpoints with minimum less than maximum.
svg.text: + Clamp(value : double, minimum : double = 0, maximum : double = 100) : double
+ Normalize(value : double, minimum : double, maximum : double) : double
+ Denormalize(normalized : double, minimum : double, maximum : double) : double
+ Distance(x1 : double, y1 : double, x2 : double, y2 : double) : double
Clamp validates finite values and ordered bounds.
Normalize/Denormalize require finite endpoints and minimum < maximum.
Distance computes Euclidean distance directly without explicit input validation.
